items.title: fix: host-mode docker default network
items.body:
Fixes #1789

Fall back to Docker network mode "default" for Docker job steps in host-mode Forgejo runner.

Currently, in host mode and with no manual `container.network` configuration, docker:// job steps use the "WORKFLOW-xxx" job network, which is not created/initialized in host mode and thus starting the container fails (see #1789). Container and Dockerfile actions work because they use Docker's "default" network in [act/runner/action.go#L499-L502](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/action.go#L499-L502). This PR uses the same logic as there: if `rc.JobContainer.ManagesOwnNetworking()` is set and there is no `container.network` configured, use the "default" network.

Claude code helped me find the source of the problem; I wrote the fix and tests (mostly copy-pasted from the test case above in the same file) myself.

items.title: bug: host-mode runner can't execute docker:// job step
items.body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

Yes

### Description

Running a docker:// job step on a host-mode runner 13.2.1 fails with the error message: [runner]: failed to start container: Error response from daemon: failed to set up container networking: network WORKFLOW-e34d3e5ab76e9ffa1bc1448a6b581344 not found

In host-mode, [act/runner/step_docker.go#L158](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/step_docker.go#L158) tries to use the job network returned by [act/runner/run_context.go#L482-L491](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/run_context.go#L482-L491), which is "WORKFLOW-xxx" by default when `container.network` is empty, but it's never created in [act/runner/run_context.go#L765-L774](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/run_context.go#L765-L774) because it's gated behind `!isHostEnv && ContainerNetworkMode == ""`.

Container and Dockerfile actions work because [act/runner/action.go#L499-L502](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/action.go#L499-L502) uses Docker's "default" network when `rc.JobContainer.ManagesOwnNetworking()`.

Minimal reproduction example: https://v18.next.forgejo.org/aarnoaukia/runner-docker-host-repro/src/branch/main/.forgejo/workflows/repro.yml
Test run using my self-hosted runner: https://v18.next.forgejo.org/aarnoaukia/runner-docker-host-repro/actions/runs/2/jobs/0/attempt/1

### Related issues

* https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/issues/1668 network option was ignored; the default didn't work
* https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/issues/1587 fix workspace for Docker steps in host-mode

### Forgejo Version

https://v18.next.forgejo.org/

### Runner Version

13.2.1

### How are you running Forgejo?

https://v18.next.forgejo.org/

### How are you running the Runner?

The runner in the repro above was registered and launched using:
$ docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" -w /data code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.1 forgejo-runner register --no-interactive --instance https://dev.next.forgejo.org --token TOKEN --name repro-host --labels host-test:host
$ docker run --rm code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.1 forgejo-runner generate-config > config.yml
$ vim config.yml  # to set log.level:debug and log.job_level:debug
$ docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" -w /data -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock --user 0 code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner:13.2.1 forgejo-runner daemon -c /data/config.yml
